comment: Maps ACC master state d000d8ee (∈{0,1,2}) -> 2-bit TSK_Status_GRA_ACC (d000d91c/d91d): 0=off,1=active(d8ee<2),2=override(d8ee==2 & d8e2 bit2),3=Fehler_nicht_moeglich(d8ee==2 & !d8e2 bit2). d91d -> (801df1e4) d000afef -> TSK CAN frames. THE status-3 producer (CRU/AC-based branch, CLF_CAN_CONF_FCT.Bit0=0). See RESULTS UPDATE 55.

name: acc05_ACC_Momentenanforderung
comment: ACC_Momentenanforderung (TORQUE/moment request, unitless 0-1021) from ACC_05/DCC_5 (0x10D) 16|10, decoded 801383fc:105 as min(b0d4*raw*16,0x7fff). NOT an acceleration (older maps mislabeled it 'the accel'). Read by 8013c5d4:734. Likely dormant on B8 (ACC_05 is Gateway_D4C7). See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: acc01_ACC_Sollbeschleunigung
comment: ACC_Sollbeschleunigung setpoint from DCC_1/ACC_01 (0x109) 24|11 (=(byte4&7)<<8|byte3), decoded 801383e8:90. Res 0.005 m/s2 offset -7.22 (=CAN_AC_DE_DCC_UP). Read by 8013c5d4:517/525 (threshold flags a580/a581). Reset default 0x5a4. On the B8 this (not d0007baa) is the received accel command. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Bremsdruck
comment: ESP-measured brake pressure from ESP_05 (0x106) 16|10 (0.3 bar, -30), decoded 80106db8:109-117 as (raw-100)*3 internal (raw 100 = 0 bar). NOT a 'second ACC setpoint' (older maps mislabeled it). Not read by 8013c5d4. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: tsk02_TSK_Verzoeg_Anf_src
comment: AC_SP_CRU_BRAKE_CTL = decel request source packed into TSK_02 (0x10C) byte8 by 80137a00. 850e-6 offset-binary; packer clamps [0x6db1=-3.984, 0x89b6=+2.112]. Set by 8013ef46:956 (=cae when a58c!=0, else 0x8000). See acc_flow.md / UPDATE 61.

name: acc_engine_torque_request
comment: ACC engine-torque request. Q5: = Ramd0007ccc passthrough (80141528:56). ACC_05 mode: = drive-off torque from d0007baa(Momentenanforderung) via 80141528:89-134. See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: acc05_ACC_Freigabe_Momentenanf
comment: ACC_Freigabe_Momentenanf (torque-request enable) from ACC_05/DCC_5 (0x10D) bit12, decoded 801383fc:92. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: acc05_ACC_Betaetigung_EPB
comment: ACC_Betaetigung_EPB (EPB-close request) from ACC_05/DCC_5 (0x10D) bit60, decoded 801383fc:114. The EPB engage bit; engine RX-decodes it (if 0x10D received). See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: acc05_ACC_limitierte_Anfahrdyn
comment: ACC_limitierte_Anfahrdyn from ACC_05/DCC_5 (0x10D) bit15, decoded 801383fc:93. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Lenkeingriff_ADS
comment: ESP_Lenkeingriff_ADS from ESP_05 (0x106) bit28, decoded 80106db8:120. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Autohold_Standby
comment: ESP_Autohold_Standby from ESP_05 (0x106) bit35, decoded 80106db8:126. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_QBit_Bremsdruck
comment: ESP_QBit_Bremsdruck (brake-pressure quality bit) from ESP_05 (0x106) bit12, decoded 80106db8:104. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Fahrer_bremst
comment: ESP_Fahrer_bremst (driver is braking) from ESP_05 (0x106) bit26, decoded 80106db8:118. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Autohold_aktiv
comment: ESP_Autohold_aktiv (ESP vehicle-hold active) from ESP_05 (0x106) bit56, decoded 80106db8:133. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_QBit_Fahrer_bremst
comment: ESP_QBit_Fahrer_bremst from ESP_05 (0x106) bit13, decoded 80106db8:105. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Verz_TSK_aktiv

name: esp05_ESP_Bremsruck_AWV2

name: esp05_ESP_Status_Bremsentemp

name: esp05_ESP_HDC_Standby
comment: ESP_HDC_Standby from ESP_05 (0x106) bit36, decoded 80106db8:127. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Rueckwaertsfahrt_erkannt
comment: ESP_Rueckwaertsfahrt_erkannt from ESP_05 (0x106) bit39, decoded 80106db8:128. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ECD_Bremslicht
comment: ECD_Bremslicht from ESP_05 (0x106) bit59, decoded 80106db8:134. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Status_Bremsdruck
comment: ESP_Status_Bremsdruck from ESP_05 (0x106) bit61, decoded 80106db8:135. Participates in the 8013ef46 decel-enable predicate (older maps called it an 'ACC enable' bit). See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ECD_nicht_verfuegbar
comment: ECD_nicht_verfuegbar from ESP_05 (0x106) bit33, decoded 80106db8:124. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Status_Anfahrhilfe
comment: ESP_Status_Anfahrhilfe from ESP_05 (0x106) bit40, decoded 80106db8:129. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ECD_Fehler
comment: ECD_Fehler from ESP_05 (0x106) bit32, decoded 80106db8:123. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Konsistenz_TSK
comment: ESP_Konsistenz_TSK (ESP TSK-request consistency/plausibility handshake) from ESP_05 (0x106) bit29, decoded 80106db8:121. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: acc_driveoff_inhibit
comment: ACC_05 drive-off inhibit = (d0001321!=0 || a54c!=0), set by 8010a6ec. Gates the drive-off torque branch in 80141528 (requires a54b==0). See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: acc_epb_hold_fault_inhibit
comment: ACC_05/EPB hold fault-inhibit word (16 conditions masked by cal 80043ccc[0x14]), set by 8010a6ec. Read by 8011101c/80137d0c/80137f2c. See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: acc_standstill_hold_confirmed
comment: ACC_05/EPB standstill-hold CONFIRMED (debounced). Set by 8010a6ec when hold timer uRamc0001062 >= cal 80043828[5]. Read by drive-off diag 8010a4fc + reset 801ab824. Cal-gated (a5a8) => dead on Q5. See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: tsk02_TSK_Freig_Verzoeg_Anf_src
comment: TSK_Freig_Verzoeg_Anf (decel-ENABLE) source, TSK_02 (0x10C) byte7 bit7. Set 8013ef46:932-936: =(a57c==0 & b28e in {1,5} & sRamc113c<=cal) || d1181. Gates whether the decel value (cb8) flows. See RESULTS UPDATE 61/64.

name: tsk02_TSK_Anhalten_src
comment: TSK_Anhalten source, packed into TSK_02 (0x10C) byte2 bit4 by 80137a00:49/94. = acc01_ACC_Anhalten(a7ae) when b28e in {1,5} & a757(LV_DCC_ENA)!=0, else 0 (8013ef46:937-943). The engine's standstill-hold request to ESP. See RESULTS UPDATE 63/64.

name: tsk02_TSK_Zwangszusch_ESP_src
comment: TSK_Zwangszusch_ESP (forced ESP coupling/intervention ENABLE) source, TSK_02 (0x10C) byte7 bit6. Set 8013ef46:963-969 = (b28f in {1,2}). Live companion enable during active ACC control; NOT an independent hold. See RESULTS UPDATE 64.

name: acc_mode_ACC05_Momentenanf_sel
comment: ACC mode select = DAT_80043caf & 1 (sole writer 801abf64:21; cal-fixed). 0 (Q5, this image caf=0x06) = ACC_01 + TSK_02(80137a00, has Anhalten) + hold-relay branch enabled in 8013ef46:850 (requires a5a8==0). 1 = ACC_05 Momentenanforderung drive-off path (80141528) + TSK_05(80137f2c) + hold-relay DISABLED. Mutually exclusive with the ACC_01 hold relay. See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: acc_driveoff_active
comment: ACC drive-off-active flag (80141528:148): true if b28e in {1,2,5,6} OR the ACC_05 Momentenanf gate. When set, Ramd0006998 carries the drive-off torque; else 0x80000000 (neutral). See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: acc05_creep_status_tsk
comment: ACC_05-path creep/low-speed status (80141528:187), from ego-speed vs cals 0x800435e2/e6. Read by TSK packers 8011101c/80137d0c/80137f2c. A status bit, NOT a hard speed floor. (a5ad sibling is dead - no readers.) See RESULTS UPDATE 66 Q3-followup.

name: coding_GRA_ena
comment: GRA (basic cruise) coding enable, long-coding cell 27 type1 (decoded 801b5900). See RESULTS UPDATE 60.

name: LV_DCC_ENA
comment: LV_DCC_ENA — ACC(Basic-ACC) coding enable from long-coding cell 27 (decoded 801b5900). a757!=0 required to forward ACC_Anhalten and selects the ACC min-accel curve (0x5b728). GRA-coded car has a757=0 and never forwards hold. See RESULTS UPDATE 60/64.

name: coding_F2S_bit_DEAD
comment: Follow-to-Stop coding bit (cell 27 type3), written only by 801b5900, read by NOTHING => F2S not implemented in this firmware. See RESULTS UPDATE 60.

name: tsk02_TSK_Codierung_ACC_src
comment: TSK_Codierung_ACC source, TSK_02 (0x10C) byte7 bit5 (coding constant via 8011101c). See acc_flow.md / UPDATE 61.

name: acc01_ACC_Anhalten
comment: ACC_Anhalten / LV_CAN_VEH_STOP_REQ_DCC — stop/hold request from DCC_1/ACC_01 (0x109) byte7 bit1, decoded 801383e8:94. Gated forward to tsk02_TSK_Anhalten_src(a58d) in 8013ef46:937 (when b28e in {1,5} & a757!=0). The standstill-hold input. See RESULTS UPDATE 63/64.

name: acc_master_compute_enable
comment: ACC master compute-enable (from 8011ac80). 8013ef46 early-returns unless ad0f!=0; also an 8013c5d4 engage gate. See acc_flow.md / UPDATE 64.

name: acc05_Momentenanf_valid
comment: ACC_05 ACC_Momentenanforderung validity status (801383fc:109): 1=valid, 2/3=SNA/invalid. Gates drive-off in 80141528 (needs b055==1). See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: acc05_ACC_StartStopp_Info
comment: ACC_StartStopp_Info from ACC_05/DCC_5 (0x10D) 44|2, decoded 801383fc:110. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: acc_ACC_Status_ACC
comment: ACC_Status_ACC (0..7) — the SAME logical signal decoded from whichever ACC frame is coding-active: ACC_01 (0x109) bit60|3 = byte7[6:4] via 801383e8:96, or ACC_05 (0x10D) bit57|3 = byte7[1:3] via 801383fc:113. Only the cal-selected frame's decoder writes it (no runtime conflict). On the Q5 (80043bc6=0x0900 -> ACC_01) it is ACC_01's field. See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: acc01_ACC_Dynamik
comment: ACC_Dynamik / CAN_STATE_DCC_DYN — DCC_1/ACC_01 (0x109) byte7 bits2-3, decoded 801383e8:95. Reader 8013e47c (torque-rate switch, but INERT: all 4 cals=500). See RESULTS UPDATE 62.

name: esp05_ESP_BKV_Unterdruck
comment: ESP_BKV_Unterdruck (brake-booster vacuum) from ESP_05 (0x106) 48|8, decoded 80106db8:132. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_StartStopp_Info
comment: ESP_StartStopp_Info from ESP_05 (0x106) 42|2, decoded 80106db8:130. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: esp05_ESP_Schwelle_Unterdruck
comment: ESP_Schwelle_Unterdruck from ESP_05 (0x106) 14|2, decoded 80106db8:107. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: STATE_CRU_CTL_CAN
comment: TSK_Status_GRA_ACC_01 source (TSK_02/0x10C byte3 bits1-0). 0..3 enum, 3=Fehler_GRA_ACC = the LATCHING fault that stops ACC. Written by the CRUC machine per state: 1(8013e47c)/5(8013e3f8)=1, 2(8013e674)=2, fault(8013e8aa@8013e910)=3. 8013e8aa has NO dispatch case for state 3 (verified in disasm 8013e8ac): once d0001165=3 the machine can only exit via full CRUC re-init 801abc7c, which runs only on an ACC master-mode cycle (disengage/re-arm or key cycle) -- hence 'latching'. THREE entry routes to 3: [A] cond-word bit3 = (a59c!=0 || b298==3), from any state; [B] cond-word bit4 = d0001177, from state 0 only; [C] coding-reset branch 8013ef46:73-84. See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: STATE_CRU_CTL
comment: Internal cruise/ACC control state (0=off/standby,1&5=regulating,2=decel-ramp split of 1,3=Fehler(latched),4=override,6=blend-out). {1,5} = actively regulating (arms TSK_Anhalten/decel). Written by 8013e8aa; internal shadow d0001165. Feeds STATE_CRU_CTL_CAN(b28d). State 3 is the terminal latch (maps/status3_routes.md).

name: STATE_CRU_CTL_long_substate
comment: Longitudinal-controller sub-state (from 8013e8aa): 1=engaged/controlling, 2=decel/approach, 3=transient, 0=off. Drives tsk02_TSK_Zwangszusch_ESP_src (a58f=(b28f in {1,2})). See RESULTS UPDATE 64/65.

name: ram_acc_vehicle_speed_mon
comment: ACC-monitor ego-speed working copy (=DAT_d000d644=clamp(d5618*32/25)), written 801efbb8:415. Scale 1/128 km/h (128 counts=1.0 km/h). = FR VS_MON. Compared vs C_VS_MIN_CRU_MON (15km/h) in 80102f60. See acc_flow.md.

name: acc_master_request_producer
comment: Stalk/master-ACC state machine; produces the master-request bytes d000b296 (mode) / b297 / b298 that feed acc_brake_request_formation (8013c5d4) and the CRUC machine. THE ESP_05 CONSUMER: it reads esp05_ECD_nicht_verfuegbar (0xd000a4f2) and debounces it over two cycles against its own previous-cycle copy d00016f0, then folds the result into the mode byte: driver-braking/override -> 1; (!esp05_ESP_Verz_TSK_aktiv || ECD-unavailable-debounced) -> 0; otherwise -> 2. NOTE this function reads no EGO-SPEED variable, which earlier work recorded as 'no speed term' -- true literally, but the speed dependence enters here via ECD_nicht_verfuegbar, which the ESP asserts as a function of speed at ~15 km/h.

name: reset_control_flags
comment: Fail-safe reset of the decoded ESP_05 ECD bits: esp05_ECD_Bremslicht = 0 (:28), esp05_ECD_nicht_verfuegbar = 1 (:30, i.e. defaults to UNAVAILABLE), esp05_ECD_Fehler = 0 (:33). It does NOT touch the master-request bytes d000b296/b299 -- those are reset in 801abe80 (:36/:39).

name: acc_master_request_mode
comment: Master-request MODE byte, written by acc_master_request_producer (801408bc:223). Values: 1 = driver braking or override active; 0 = TSK deceleration inactive OR ECD unavailable (debounced); 2 = ECD available AND TSK decel active. Read by acc_brake_request_formation (8013c5d4) at :569, :711 and :1043, each testing == 2 -- so ECD unavailability drops the mode to 0 and removes those active branches on the way to the brake request Ramd0007c9a. Also read by 8013e13c/8013e3f8/8013e674/8013e8aa/8013ef46 (the CRUC machine); reset in 801abe80:36. This is how the ESP's ECD declaration reaches TSK_02, INDEPENDENTLY of the C_VS_MIN_CRU_MON latching L2 fault, which contains no esp05_ reference at all.

name: acc_ecd_unavail_debounced
comment: Debounced ECD-unavailable flag: (selected ECD bit this cycle AND its previous-cycle value), written at acc_master_request_producer 801408bc:222 and read back by the same function at :62 as the previous-cycle term. Reset in 801abe80:39. The functional effect travels via d000b296, not via this byte -- nothing outside 801408bc consumes it.

name: esp05_ECD_nicht_verfuegbar_prev
comment: Previous-cycle copy of esp05_ECD_nicht_verfuegbar, stored at the tail of acc_master_request_producer (801408bc:544-545). Forms the 2-cycle debounce with the current value.

name: esp05_ECD_Fehler_prev
comment: Previous-cycle copy of esp05_ECD_Fehler, stored alongside d00016f0 at 801408bc:546-547; same 2-cycle debounce pattern applied to the ECD fault bit.

name: acc_brake_enable_mode2
comment: Enable flag in acc_brake_request_formation (8013c5d4:569-575): set to 1 only when uRamc00010b8 is below its cal threshold AND acc_master_request_mode == 2 AND a further condition; 0 otherwise. One of the three places ECD unavailability removes brake-request authority.

name: acc_brake_mode2_alt_flag
comment: Flag set in acc_brake_request_formation (8013c5d4:1043-1047) where acc_master_request_mode == 2 acts as an ALTERNATIVE to a threshold comparison (Ramd0007c98 < iVar27), gated by iVar23 < sRamc00010da. Third of the three mode-2 gates on the path to Ramd0007c9a.

name: cal_ecd_debounce_source_select
comment: Selects WHICH ESP_05 ECD bit acc_master_request_producer debounces into d000b296 (801408bc:66, tested as WORD_ARRAY_80043ccc[2] & 1): bit clear -> esp05_ECD_Fehler; bit set -> esp05_ECD_nicht_verfuegbar. This image holds 0x01, so ECD_nicht_verfuegbar is the operative source. NOTE clearing this bit does not remove the gate, it only switches which ECD bit drives it.

name: programming_session_reflash_loop
comment: UDS programming-session executor: sets base regs, flash_driver_init(0x800826c0) loads the reflash op-descriptor, then a watchdog-serviced service loop (STM_TIM0 us pacing, toggles P0_OMR pin from _DAT_c03fcc94) until DAT_c03fcc9x signals done; finishes via FUN_801d3b94 and UNK_d000ad7a=1

name: flash_driver_init
comment: Flash driver init: zeroes state block @0xc03fd380, stores reflash-descriptor root (param_1) into flash_descriptor_root, populates segment table via FUN_801f2d30, sets flash_staging_ptr=0xc03fd3d0

name: flash_write_dispatch
comment: UDS RequestDownload/TransferData WRITE dispatcher: bounds-checks [offset,offset+len) subset-of segment (else NRC 0x80), requires cmd byte0==reflash_cmd_signature(DAT_800826d4), routes to flash_write_transfer. Segment record stride 0x14 at flash_descriptor_root[4]+idx*0x14; refuses idx>=flash_segment_count

name: flash_erase_dispatch
comment: Erase-op dispatcher (sibling of flash_write_dispatch): validates segment idx<flash_segment_count and cmd byte, routes to flash_erase_segment_loop(801f3fb8)

name: flash_write_transfer
comment: THE write path: installs flash op vtable (@c03fd390 program=flash_program_page), computes target=descriptor[seg].addr+off|0xa0000000, streams request bytes into staging buffer 0xc03fd3d0 page-by-page (page size from DAT_801f2cf8+i*0x14), programs each full page via flash_program_page_exec(801f39b4); watchdog-serviced. Never accepts an out-of-segment address

name: flash_program_page_exec
comment: Program-one-page executor: watchdog-service, get_status_code, calls program op _DAT_c03fd390(=flash_program_page) then verify_flash_data_801f1cf0

name: flash_program_page
comment: TC1796 PMU program-page: fills page assembly buffer (param_1+0x55f0) with 16/32 dwords from staging buffer 0xc03fd3d0, issues program unlock seq 0xAA/0x55/0xA0 then 0xAA, polls FLASH_FSR (0x800 PROER, 0x400 PFOPER, 0x10, 0x80000000 busy/done); gated by cmd sig byte3 DAT_800826d7; latches errors into per-segment status(+0xc)/flash_error_flags

name: flash_erase_sector
comment: TC1796 PMU erase-sector: issues 0xF5(clear-status)/0xAA/0x55/0x80/0xAA/0x55 then confirm word (sector*0x10+0x30), polls FLASH_FSR, retries x3; gated by cmd sig byte3 DAT_800826d7

name: flash_erase_segment_loop
comment: Whole-segment erase executor: flash_find_sector_range -> [first,last] sector then loops EVERY sector in the descriptor segment unconditionally calling flash_erase_sector -> wipes the entire 256K cal segment to 0xFF. No sub-sector/single-sector erase exists

name: flash_blank_check
comment: Post-erase blank/verify: reads region via 0xa0000000 (PFLASH)/0xafe00000-0xafe20000 (DFLASH) alias, checks all bytes==0xFF (erased) using MARD margin-read (update_flash_mard_801f1fc4) around the two DFLASH banks; NRC 0x20 on mismatch

name: flash_find_sector_range
comment: Maps [segbase, segbase+size) to a physical sector index range -> flash_sector_first/flash_sector_last, from the sector geometry table at param_1+0xc (8-byte {start,end} sector records)

name: uds_service_dispatch
comment: THE UDS service dispatcher (sole request/response path). Walks the linked-list SID registry (12-byte records), matches the incoming SID, calls uds_access_gate; if permitted invokes the record handler (*(code*)(handler&~1))(ctx,arg), else writes NRC 0x33/0x13. No raw-CAN CCP/XCP command-byte switch exists anywhere in parallel -> Door 3 (CCP/XCP UPLOAD) is absent

name: uds_access_gate
comment: Per-service session/security gate: ANDs the service attr byte (0x30/0x31/0x70/0x71 from the SID record) against the active session mask (ctx->session & 0xc); returns 0x11 serviceNotSupported when not permitted (0x33 securityAccessDenied upstream), else forwards via PTR_check_status_and_update_flag_80080234

name: UDS_REFLASH_DESCRIPTOR
comment: Reflash op-descriptor root: count=5, segment-array ptrs 0x8008265c/0x80082654; programs CALIBRATION (0xa0040000, 256K) + DFLASH/EEPROM (0xafe00000/0xafe10000) only — NOT the ASW code banks and NOT the boot sector

name: reflash_cmd_signature
comment: 4-byte reflash command signature {0x53,0x65,0xca,0x35} (u32 0x35CA6553). The UDS transfer command word (param_5) bytes 0..3 must equal DAT_800826d4..d7 in flash_write_dispatch/flash_write_transfer/flash_program_page/flash_erase_sector or the op is rejected (NRC 0x02). Acts as a fixed magic gating the flash primitives

name: flash_descriptor_root
comment: Flash driver: active reflash op-descriptor root ptr (set by flash_driver_init; =0x800826c0 for the UDS reflash path). Segment records live at [this+4]+idx*0x14 {flags,addr,size,...}

name: flash_seg_status_array
comment: Flash driver: per-segment status record array base (idx*0x10; +0xc is the FSR error/status accumulator word for that segment)

name: flash_scratch_ptr
comment: Flash driver: scratch/definition buffer ptr, cleared via fill_memory_800a5988 after each op

name: flash_error_flags
comment: Flash driver: global FLASH_FSR error accumulator for out-of-range segment index (|=0x80040400 prot/oper err, 0x20000 program err, 2 verify err)

name: flash_op_program
comment: Flash op vtable[0]: program/erase primitive fn ptr — flash_program_page(801f249e) in write mode, flash_erase_sector(801f2224) in erase mode

name: flash_op_service
comment: Flash op vtable[2]: watchdog/comm service fn invoked on the STM_TIM3 interval during long flash ops (compared vs sentinel _DAT_c03fd39c to detect 'no service installed')

name: flash_op_issue
comment: Flash op vtable[4]: PMU command-issue/resume fn (FUN_801f274a)

name: flash_service_interval
comment: Flash driver: STM_TIM3 tick threshold between watchdog/comm service calls during flash ops

name: flash_last_service_tim3
comment: Flash driver: STM_TIM3 timestamp of the last service call

name: flash_segment_count
comment: Flash driver: number of segments in the active descriptor (=5), populated by FUN_801f2d30. Segment-index bound: idx>=this routes the op to flash_error_flags instead of a real segment

name: flash_error_latch
comment: Flash driver: set to 1 on any FLASH_FSR error during program/erase

name: flash_staging_ptr
comment: Flash driver: staging buffer ptr = 0xc03fd3d0 (where TransferData bytes are assembled before programming)

name: flash_cur_write_addr
comment: Flash driver: current page write target = descriptor[seg].addr+off|0xa0000000 (non-cached PFLASH alias)

name: flash_last_write_addr
comment: Flash driver: previous page write target, used for page-boundary detection in flash_write_transfer

name: FLASH_PAGE_STAGING_BUFFER
comment: Reflash staging buffer: UDS TransferData payload is assembled here, then flash_program_page copies 128/256-byte pages from it into the TC1796 PMU page-assembly buffer

name: flash_sector_first
comment: flash_find_sector_range output: first physical sector index of the segment being erased

name: flash_sector_last
comment: flash_find_sector_range output: last physical sector index of the segment being erased

name: flash_erase_pending
comment: Flash driver: erase-in-progress flag (set 1 by flash_erase_segment_loop, consumed/cleared by flash_write_transfer to sequence erase-before-program)

name: acc_ext_fault_or_ROUTE_A
comment: ROUTE A anchor. External-fault OR feeding CRUC cond-word bit3 (8013ef46:731: bit3 set if a59c!=0 || b298==3 -> STATE_CRU_CTL=3 from ANY state). Built 801408bc:296-302: a59c = ((fault_word c000118a & cal_0x80043cf2) != 0) || (d00016e9 != 0). Mask 0x80043cf2 = 0xFFFF so all 16 fault-word bits are live. The 16 bits are ACC input-signal validity / DTC-active flags (COM descriptor bit2 or DTC substitution); full table in maps/status3_routes.md. d00016e9 is a 17th independent sensor/actuator-validity OR term.

name: acc_sensor_valid_or_ROUTE_A
comment: ROUTE A 17th term. Sensor/actuator-validity OR (built 801408bc:220 = d00016e9-fault word & cal 0x80043296=0xFF). a59c=1 if this !=0 even when the 16-bit fault_word is clear. See acc_ext_fault_or_ROUTE_A (d000a59c) / maps/status3_routes.md.

name: egas_l2_monitor_aggregate_fault_ROUTE_A_bit6
comment: EGAS-L2 monitor AGGREGATE fault = a03c || a040 || d0001856 (8009c0b4:837). Feeds Route A fault-word bit 0x40 -> a59c -> CRUC status 3, and the GRA fault latch a551 (8013b0ec d00011a0 bit4). The acceleration-side fault: torque-vs-ACC-status plausibility, SPEED-INDEPENDENT (not the ECD decel gate, not a 15 km/h floor). See status3_routes.md / low_speed_floors.md.

name: acc_main_state_enum
comment: ACC main-state enum from 801408bc (d00016ea, committed :500). Values 0/1/3/4. b298==3 -> CRUC cond-word bit3 -> STATE_CRU_CTL=3 (ROUTE A). Reaches 3 via 801408bc:440 (bVar2=coding OFF path) or :449-472 selector d00016ee(bit0-1)/d00016ec(bit2-3)/d00016ed(bit4-5) of bVar23 (assist-fault word, cal 0x8004327a[0xf]) or mirror of GRA main state b286. See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: gra_main_state
comment: GRA (basic-cruise) main state, written 8013a754 (0=off,1=engaged/controlling,3=fault). b286=3 -> b298=3 -> CRUC status 3 (ROUTE A). b286=3 is the GRA fault park, reached when the GRA fault latch a551!=0 (LAB_8013aa62). Also mirrored into b297 (ROUTE B input). See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: gra_fault_latch
comment: GRA fault latch. Set 8013b0ec:239 when (d00011a0 & cal 0x8004340e=0x77)!=0; the d00011a0 bits are input/plausibility faults incl. bit0(aa6f|a9ed sensor), bit1(a9a5), bit2(aa3f&a3b4 brake-signal), bit4(a68a|a62e|a62f|a07a|a03b|a62d cluster incl. EGAS-L2), bit5(b28a). a551!=0 forces GRA main state b286=3 (8013a754) -> b298=3 -> CRUC status 3. Cleared by 801ab860 (CRUC/master re-init). See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: acc_brakeoverride_fault_timer_ROUTE_B
comment: ROUTE B anchor. Sets CRUC cond-word bit4 (8013ef46:738) which -> STATE_CRU_CTL=3 but ONLY from state 0 (8013e8aa:8013e8cc; bit4 is not consulted in states 1/2/4/5). Built 8013ef46:106-130: d0001177=1 after b296==1 (driver braking/override) AND b297==1 (high-level cruise still ENGAGED) held together for cal 0x8004377c = 20 consecutive cycles; the timer wRamc0001170 resets whenever b296!=1 OR b297!=1. So it is NOT 'braking in standby' per se -- it is a persistent driver-brake-override while the high-level engage-state failed to cancel (a stuck-override / failed-cancel plausibility fault). See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: acc_brakeoverride_inhibit_ROUTE_B
comment: ROUTE B precursor. d0001176=1 after b296==1 (driver braking/override) held cal 0x8004377a = 3 cycles; feeds inhibit word d0001169 bit0 -> d0001160 (mask 0x80043422=0xEF) -> CRUC cond-word bit1 -> forces exit from {1,5} to standby (state 0). This is the NORMAL brake-cancel. If the brake-override then persists 20 cycles with b297 still ENGAGED, d0001177 escalates it to the status-3 latch (ROUTE B). See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: acc_engage_state_mirror_ROUTE_B
comment: High-level cruise/ACC engage-state mirror, written 801408bc:423-438: = GRA main state b286 (if GRA-coded) else DCC substate b29d (if ACC-coded). Value 1 = engaged/active. ROUTE B fault requires b297==1 to persist WITH driver braking (b296==1) for 20 cycles -> d0001177 -> status 3. If a brake tap properly cancels cruise, b297 leaves 1 and the d0001177 timer resets. See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: cal_acc_ext_fault_mask_ROUTE_A
comment: ROUTE A mask (WORD_ARRAY_80043ccc[0x13]). u16=0xFFFF in this image -> all 16 fault-word bits are live in a59c (801408bc:296). Zeroing a bit here would remove that fault from the status-3 path. See acc_ext_fault_or_ROUTE_A / maps/status3_routes.md.

name: cal_acc_brake_inhibit_debounce_ROUTE_B
comment: ROUTE B d0001176 debounce (WORD_ARRAY_80043774[3]). u16=3 cycles of b296==1 before the brake-override inhibit asserts (normal brake-cancel to standby). See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: cal_acc_brake_fault_debounce_ROUTE_B
comment: ROUTE B d0001177 debounce (WORD_ARRAY_80043774[4]). u16=20 cycles of (b296==1 AND b297==1) before the brake-override escalates to the status-3 latch. See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: cal_gra_fault_mask
comment: GRA fault-latch mask (a551). u8=0x77 in this image: selects which d00011a0 plausibility bits (8013b0ec) latch GRA main state to fault (b286=3 -> b298=3 -> CRUC status 3, ROUTE A). See gra_fault_latch (d000a551) / maps/status3_routes.md.

name: cal_acc_coding_reset_status3_gate_ROUTE_C
comment: ROUTE C gate (byte at WORD_ARRAY_80043ccc[0x59] high byte). u8=0x01 (live) in this image. In the 8013ef46:73-84 coding-reset branch (entered when ECU is neither GRA- nor DCC-coded, or ACC_05 mode selected), STATE_CRU_CTL_CAN=3 iff d000aab5!=0 AND this cal !=0; else 0. A wrong-coding / unsupported-mode fault (e.g. why VCDS rejects F2S). See maps/status3_routes.md.

name: acc_status_error_aggregator_body
comment: Body of the ACC status/diagnosis aggregator (80102f60 prologue falls through into here). Builds the 13-way diagnosis accumulator d000d8e0 (:709) from 13 RELAYED CAN symptoms (debouncers d714..d740, inputs d5b5/d5bb/d62b/d5d8/d5f5/d670/d67f/d685/d693/d695/d680/d5fc/d683 copied by 801dec08 -- NONE speed-derived), the key-cycle latch d8b4, d8e2, and the 15 km/h crawl monitor (d79a/d7a7/d8ab). See low_speed_floors.md sec.1 CORRECTION + acc_flow.md.

name: crawl_monitor_below15_debounced
comment: Internal 15 km/h L2 crawl-monitor debounced output (VS_MON da54 <= cal 0x800794ef*0x80 in 80102f60). REPORTING-ONLY: feeds d000d88b bit5 (never tested) and d79e->d88b bit4. Does NOT reach the status-3 latch d8e0 (fed by relayed symptoms only) nor gate braking. Per FR ch.14.16 this is the C_VS_MIN_CRU_MON monitor-ARMING side, not a fault. See low_speed_floors.md sec.1.

name: crawl_monitor2_below15
comment: Second 15 km/h crawl-monitor output (band at cal 0x800794f2, 80102f60). Copied by 801031bc to d000a35f -> telltale field on CAN frame 0x5C0 (80137084). REPORTING-ONLY; no fault, no control gate. See low_speed_floors.md sec.1.

name: acc_monitor_status_word
comment: ACC aggregator status bit-word. Crawl-monitor bits 3(d7a7/d794)/4(d79e)/5(d79a) are WRITTEN BUT NEVER TESTED; only bits 0/1/6/7 are read internally. Evidence the 15 km/h crawl monitor is reporting-only. See low_speed_floors.md sec.1.

name: tsk_status_5c0_crawl_field
comment: CAN-export field on frame 0x5C0 (= crawl-monitor d000d8ab, via 801031bc; packed by 80137084:95). The internal 15 km/h monitor's only functional escape -- a telltale/status field, not a control gate. See low_speed_floors.md sec.1.

name: acc_diag_accumulator_13way
comment: 13-way ACC diagnosis accumulator (Ramd000d8e0), built 801dfe06:709 from 13 RELAYED CAN symptoms only (debounced ==3). NONE is speed- or crawl-derived (verified). Chain: d8e0 -> d744 -> d8b4 (key-cycle latch) -> d8e2.bit2 -> 801eca44 -> d91d status enum on frame 0x5C0. This is the SECOND status-3 channel; like the CRUC b28d channel it has NO ego-speed input. See low_speed_floors.md sec.1 / status3_routes.md.

name: acc_diag_keycycle_latch
comment: Key-cycle latch for the ACC diagnosis accumulator (801dfe06: gates recompute -- accumulator only rebuilt while d8b4==0). Debounced from d8e0 via d744. Latches the 0x5C0 status-3 until an ACC re-arm/key cycle. Fed by relayed symptoms, not speed. See status3_routes.md.

name: acc_master_state
comment: ACC master state (0=off,1=active,2=engaged), set in the aggregator (80102f60/801dfe06/801e0012). Feeds the status mapper 801eca44 (d8ee + d8e2.bit2 -> d91c/d91d 0..3). Build reads no ego-speed/crawl-monitor. See status3_routes.md.

name: acc_status_enum_5c0
comment: ACC status enum (0=nicht_verbaut,1=aktiv,2=uebersteuert,3=Fehler_GRA_ACC), from 801eca44 (d8ee + d8e2.bit2). Packed into CAN frame 0x5C0 (via afef, 80137084). This is the SECOND status-3 channel (distinct from TSK_Status_GRA_ACC_01=b28d on TSK_02); it is driven by the relayed-symptom accumulator d8e0 and is likewise SPEED-INDEPENDENT. Prior docs' 'd91d/b28d' were conflated -- there is NO d91d->b28d write. See status3_routes.md.

name: acc_status_enum_5c0_can_mirror
comment: CAN-export mirror of the 0x5C0 ACC status enum (= d000d91d, via 801df1e4). Read by 80137084 (frame 0x5C0 packer). See d000d91d / status3_routes.md.

name: egas_l2_cruise_torque_monitor
comment: EGAS-L2 (ASIL) cruise/torque safety monitor -- the ACCELERATION-side analog of the ESP ECD decel gate. Arms on acc_ACC_Status_ACC(b057) in {3,4} + a03f==0 (ae80>=cal(0)=always, long_substate!=0x37=always -> inert). When ACC commands positive torque while NOT armed, a debounce counter expires -> permitted torque forced to 0 -> a040/a03c=1 -> a03b -> Route A status 3. READS NO EGO SPEED (verified grep+disasm). The '15/13' cals it holds (C_VS_MIN_CRU_MON_L2 0x456bd/c0, _OFF 0x456c3) are DEBOUNCE COUNTER presets, NOT speed compares (disasm 8009ce4a: d9=d9-(d9!=0) countdown). Per FR ch.14.16.2 C_VS_MIN_CRU_MON is the monitor-ARMING speed (SET LV_CRU_MON_ACT_MON above ~15), not a fault floor. See low_speed_floors.md sec.1 + status3_routes.md.

name: egas_l2_torque_monitor_companion
comment: Companion of egas_l2_cruise_torque_monitor (8009c0b4); computes the torque-plausibility flag a03f and the arming input ae80. Reads NO ego speed. See 8009c0b4.

name: egas_l2_cruise_speed_monitor_fault
comment: EGAS-L2 sub-fault: set 8009c0b4:460 when permitted-torque(uVar18) < requested ACC torque(acc_engine_torque_request hi) and a ~12-cycle debounce (cal 0x8004566c) expires, while drive-off d1855==0. Feeds a03b. No speed input. See 8009c0b4.

name: egas_l2_torque_monitor_fault
comment: EGAS-L2 torque sub-fault (8009c0b4), torque-vs-permitted comparison. Feeds the aggregate a03b (with a040,d1856). No speed input. See 8009c0b4.

name: egas_l2_aggregate_fault_mirror
comment: EGAS-L2 aggregate fault mirror = a03c||a040||d1856 (8009c0b4:840), set alongside a03b. See 8009c0b4.

name: acc_driveoff_active
comment: ACC drive-off / L2-armed state (=acc_driveoff_active, 800a0c9c:139). In 8009c0b4: when 1, permitted torque = requested (no fault); when 0, the debounce counter runs and can force permitted torque to 0 -> L2 fault. Tracks the monitor arming bVar1 (ACC active). See 8009c0b4.

name: egas_l2_torque_plausibility_flag
comment: EGAS-L2 torque-plausibility flag (set 8009cf94). a03f!=0 disarms the 8009c0b4 monitor's 'legit ACC active' condition. No speed input. See 8009c0b4.

name: egas_l2_monitor_arming_input
comment: EGAS-L2 arming input (8009cf94->8009c0b4). Compared ae80 >= cal WORD_ARRAY_800456dd[3]; cal = 0x00 in this image so the term is always true (inert). See 8009c0b4.

name: tsk_pack_status_frame_5c0
comment: Packs CAN frame 0x5C0 (TX scheduler 80106ed8:676, mask 0x4). Fields: ACC status enum afef(=d91d), a35f(=crawl-monitor d8ab telltale), a365/a362. The status-report frame -- distinct from TSK_02(0x10C, packer 80137a00). See status3_routes.md / low_speed_floors.md.

name: acc_crawl_to_5c0_copier
comment: Copies the 15 km/h crawl-monitor output d000d8ab -> d000a35f (the 0x5C0 telltale field). The monitor's only functional escape. See low_speed_floors.md sec.1.
